about: Ratchet & Clank: Going Commando's binding for mods (docs/port/MODS.md, sections 4 and 11): its hook points. sdk/tools/gen_binding.py writes port/game/rac2/script_binding.c, sdk/include/openrac/games/rac2.hpp and sdk/types/rac2.d.luau from it, with every hook point's permanent id and aliases (rac2.ids.lock); --check holds the hook points to the hook rows of port/game/rac2-<disc>/libraries.tsv. Symbols are each disc's (the NTSC-U v1.01 disc first, where the ids are anchored; PAL and NTSC-U v2.00 as port/tools/hostgen/release_carry.py pairs them). An id reuses rac1's <area>.<name> for the same job (openrac-mods docs/MULTI_GAME.md).

hooks.name: Hero_TakeDamage
hooks.about: Takes a hit's points from the hero's health (the hero at 0x189E20 on NTSC-U, health at +0x24CC), after the armour's scale; the hero's state machine calls it for each hit.

hooks.name: Moby_GetHitMessage
hooks.about: The pending hit for a moby from the hit ring (the damage, f32 at +0x2C; its source at +0x38), or 0: what an enemy's damage path reads.

hooks.name: Weapon_TakeAmmo
hooks.about: Takes rounds of a weapon's ammo (item -1: the one in hand); a weapon with no capacity has endless ammo. Rac1's TakeAmmo.

hooks.name: Moby_RecordDeath
hooks.about: A moby's death recorded: its experience, the bestiary and its bolt drop (the moby's s16 at +0xB4); crates call it too.

hooks.name: Level_Load
hooks.about: Loads a level (new, or resumed after a death); it calls the gameplay file's loader.

hooks.name: Hero_ApproachSpeed
hooks.about: Eases the hero's speed (+0x1B4) toward his target speed (+0x1B0) each tick, at up when speeding up and down when slowing; rac1's approach_speed.

hooks.name: Hero_NanotechSteps
hooks.about: Adds the nanotech levels' steps of health to *count; the recount of the most health each tick adds the boosts after it (the HUD's experience bar calls it too, ignoring count).

hooks.name: Item_Give
hooks.about: Gives the player item id (GiveInventoryItem): nothing when it is owned already; else sets its owned and new bytes, its starting ammo, adds it to the vendor's list and the quick select. The NPCs, pickups, arena prizes, the vendor's purchases and the start's items go through it; a few places set the owned bytes themselves (Endako's packs and Grindboots, Aranos Prison's Qwark Statuette). Rac1's GiveItem.

hooks.name: Item_Equip
hooks.about: Puts item id in the hero's hand, or on him for the boots, helmets and packs (by the state of its record in the item table): a request his update carries out; 1 when one was made. Most givers call it right after Item_Give with the same id (Todano's Sheepinator, the Tractor Beam, the Thermanator, the Swingshot, the Mapper, ...), the vendor after a purchase; a mod that gives another item in a giver's place hands it this one's too.

hooks.name: Planet_Unlock
hooks.about: Puts a level on the ship's map (MarkLevelAvailable): its byte at 0x1A7BC8 and its place in the map's order (0x139948, on NTSC-U v1.01). Coordinate sellers, story scenes and ship challenges call it, and every level load calls it for the level loaded. Rac1's UnlockPlanet.

hooks.name: Moby_DynamoPickup_Update
hooks.about: Oozla's Dynamo pickup outside the Megacorp store (class 2709): plays its scene and gives item 36; tests item 36's owned byte.

hooks.name: Moby_TractorBeamSeller_Update
hooks.about: Oozla's Megacorp scientist (class 2766): sells the Tractor Beam (item 46) for its record's price; tests item 46's owned byte.

hooks.name: Moby_BoxBreakerPickup_Update
hooks.about: Oozla's Box Breaker pickup (class 4688): removes itself while item 50 is owned, else gives it.

hooks.name: Moby_ThermanatorSeller_Update
hooks.about: Barlow's inventor (class 3390): sells the Thermanator (item 39); tests item 39's owned byte.

hooks.name: Moby_ThermanatorArea_Update
hooks.about: Barlow's level start: with item 39 owned and the area's story byte (+0x12 of 0x1395B8) clear, starts the hero in the Thermanator's area.

hooks.name: Moby_SwingshotArea_Update
hooks.about: Endako's level start: with item 13 owned and the area's story byte (+0x0D of 0x1395B8) clear, starts the hero in the Swingshot's area.

hooks.name: Moby_GliderPickup_Update
hooks.about: Tabora's Glider (class 3675): after its scene gives item 21; tests item 21's owned byte.

hooks.name: Moby_LevitatorSeller_Update
hooks.about: Joba's shady salesman (class 3733): sells the Levitator (item 8); tests item 8's owned byte.

hooks.name: Moby_ChargeBootsRider_Update
hooks.about: Joba's hoverbike race rider (class 2940): after the race's scene gives the Charge Boots (item 54) while they are not owned.

hooks.name: Moby_RaceController_Update
hooks.about: The hoverbike race's controller of Barlow and Joba (class 3004): on Joba gives the Charge Boots (item 54) while they are not owned; on Barlow puts Feltzin on the map.

hooks.name: Moby_MapperReturn_Update
hooks.about: Damosel's return from the Giant Clank battle (class 3841): gives the Mapper (item 5) while it is not owned.

hooks.name: Moby_HypnomaticMaker_Update
hooks.about: Damosel's Hypnomatic maker (class 4754): with the three parts sells the Hypnomatic (item 55); tests item 55's owned byte.

hooks.name: Moby_NanotechBall_Update
hooks.about: The nanotech orb's update (class 0x326, the orb in a nanotech crate): flies its pieces to the hero, who gains health as each lands (+0x24CC of the hero, at most his max health), 1 a piece or 4 for the special orb. Rac1's nanotech_ball update.
